name: SPSETIA
recent: S P Setia 于 2026 年 11 月 11 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度业绩，盈利表现低于市场预期，多家券商下调盈利预测。同期，EPF 在两天内减持近 400 万股，股价单日下跌约 8%。此外，公司就出售 275.40 英亩土地予 Mah Sing 旗下子公司一事，将条件满足期限延长一个月至 2026 年 12 月 2 日。
notable: 条件满足期限延长至 2026 年 12 月 2 日。

risks: EPF 在两天内减持近 400 万股。

earnings: 最新财报（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度）营收为 MYR 821,385,000，净利润为 MYR 98,059,000，净利率 11.9%。营收环比下降 0.6%，净利润环比增长 215.1%；营收同比下降 13.0%，净利润同比下降 1.7%。

recent_en: S P Setia announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 11 November 2026, with earnings missing market expectations and several brokers cutting their forecasts. Meanwhile, EPF sold nearly 4 million shares over two days, and the share price fell about 8% in a single day. The company also extended the conditional period for the disposal of approximately 275.40 acres of land to Mah Sing's wholly-owned subsidiaries by one month to 2 December 2026.
notable_en: Proposed disposal by indirect wholly-owned subsidiary Petaling Garden Sdn Bhd of approximately 275.40 acres of freehold land to two wholly-owned subsidiaries of Mah Sing Group Berhad, with the conditional period extended to 2 December 2026.
Announced quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
EPF sold nearly 4 million shares over two days.
risks_en: EPF sold nearly 4 million shares over two days.
Quarterly earnings missed market expectations, and several brokers cut their earnings forecasts.
The share price fell about 8% in a single day.
earnings_en: For the latest financial period ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 821,385,000 and net income was MYR 98,059,000, with a net margin of 11.9%. Revenue fell 0.6% QoQ while net income rose 215.1% QoQ; revenue declined 13.0% YoY and net income declined 1.7% YoY.
